Name: Quest Helper
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod implements some simple QoL additions to quests.

It adds quest markers (like the one in front of Pierre's) to NPCs if you have items to deliver to them (only if the item is in your inventory) or if you are supposed to talk to them.

It adds quest markers to monsters you are supposed to kill.

It adds location and weather info to fishing quest descriptions to help you find fish.

It adds item crafting and cooking data to quests that involve specific items.

It adds the names of everyone you have still to talk to for socializing quests like Introductions.
